notes: Zero cause/effect (eitza or cause-type) edges exist in the dataset for reference 181. The Torah source text contains a rich causal chain (conspiracy → aggregation of kavod portions → neutralization of target's kavod → downfall → lust), but these relationships have not been entered into torahData.js as formal eitza/cause edges. The gap analysis (torah_181_additions.json) confirms this: all non-bechina concepts (kesher, chelkei ha-kavod, resha'im, nefilah, taavat niuf, machaloket Korach, tzaddik ha-emet) play eitza-only roles in the text but are not present in the dataset. No enrichment is possible until cause/effect edges are added to the dataset.
